name: Kinetic Editorial
tagline: ouerf-man's kinetic editorial: cream and black scenes hard-cut against each other, one red, words blur in on the syllable.

motion.direction: ouerf-man kinetic editorial. Every spoken word appears as said and stays, building the sentence; the block leaves on the cut. Setup words IBM Plex Sans 500 (≈84 px), the ONE keyword per block 700 at 170 px in red `ter`; words reveal blur 16–26 px → 0 with scale 1.2 → 1 in 5–9 frames, the keyword as a `slam` landing on its syllable. Scenes ≈1.4 s; light `mar` and dark `stage` scenes hard-cut against each other (max 2–3 of one tone in a row — use `card`/`arch` for dark, `full` for light). Push-in 1.05–1.12 per scene, a shake on impacts; soft tap per word, thud on keywords. One literal hero object per clause.
